decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The development would by reason of the proposed side extension and increased height to the rear outrigger, represent an uncharacteristic and undesirable form of development that would cause harm to the character and appearance of the locally listed dwellinghouse, wider streetscene and Charlwood Road & Lifford Street Conservation Area, contrary to LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Local Plan as well as Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policy HC1 (C) of the London Plan (2021).

Reason : 2 - The development would by reason the overly tall boundary treatment and loss of vegetated garden land, represent an uncharacteristic and undesirable form of development that would cause harm to the character and appearance of the locally listed dwellinghouse, wider streetscene and Charlwood Road & Lifford Street Conservation Area, contrary to LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan as well as Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policy HC1 (C) of the London Plan (2021).

Reason : 3 - The development would, in the absence of sufficient information, fail to demonstrate that the proposed basement and landscaping would not increase flood risk on or off site, contrary to Policies LP6 and LP12 of the Local Plan.

description:
Demolition of existing side entrance stairs and lean to; erection of lower ground floor extension including alterations to the landscaping at the rear; 1.5 storey side extension (lower ground and upper ground); increasing the height and depth of the existing 2.5 storey rear addition; dormer extension to rear roof slope
and rooflights to main roof slope; alterations to fenestration; installation of solar panels to flat rooves; alterations to front drive and access; removal of two small trees to the rear.
